ground_interface.evidence_limit: Geometric contact of concept plate proxy with datum plane only; no sole/contact material, deflection, stability or load is validated.

validation_scope: OCC solid validity, source mesh bbox, and STEP round-trip are checked. Bbox containment is not surface fit, collision clearance, kinematics or physical validation.
not_verified: The 1350 mm scale is a working design choice, not a measured scale from the source mesh.
Skeleton members, joint modules, sensor volumes and shells are provisional packing envelopes, not selected components.
Only overall bounding-box containment is reported; this is not a mesh-interference or collision proof.
Joint axes, motion range, kinematics, actuator torque/speed, thermal capacity, wire routing, service access, stiffness and impact loads are not validated.
Mass properties, center of mass, support polygon, contact friction and dynamic balance are not computed.
The source appearance mesh is not segmented, watertight or suitable for manufacturing. Replace it with independently designed removable shells after engineering constraints are available.
